author: Rock Hill SC Daily Brief
title: 🐶 Sweet Rock Hill Dogs Ready Now for Loving Adoption
text:
7 hours ago Rock Hill has some wonderful dogs waiting for a loving home. Here are a few pups from Halfway There Rescue who are ready to meet you.
Moira Breed: Australian Kelpie mix Age: Puppy (baby) Gender: Female Color: Black with tan/yellow/fawn markings Shelter: Halfway There Rescue (Rock Hill, SC) Moira is a young Australian Kelpie mix pup, full of potential and puppy charm. Kelpies are known as smart, active working dogs, so Moira will likely do best with a family ready for play, training, and daily exercise.
If you’re looking for a bright, athletic dog to grow up with your family, Moira could be the perfect match. Please check her listing for more details on her vetting, training, and current needs.
👉 Meet Moira and apply to adopt on adoptapet
Sudie Breed: Beagle mix Age: 4-month-old puppy (baby) Gender: Female Color: Tan/yellow/fawn with white Personality: Playful, energetic, curious, adventurous Training: Making great progress with potty training, crate trained , sleeps through the night Shelter: Halfway There Rescue (Rock Hill, SC) Sudie is a sweet, bouncy 4‑month‑old Beagle mix who loves life. She’s playful, energetic, and always ready for fun with her foster dog brother. She enjoys chewing on her bone, exploring, and discovering new things.
Her foster reports she is a quick learner . She’s already crate trained and sleeping through the night , and she’s doing well with potty training . With consistent guidance, she should grow into a well-mannered family dog.
If you want a fun, active pup to join your adventures, Sudie might be your girl.
👉 Meet Sudie and apply to adopt on adoptapet
